title: Safe working order.
officialText: Scaffolds, all components of and attachments to the scaffold, and all supports and anchorages of the scaffold shall be provided to the site in a safe working order by their respective owner, with no known hazardous conditions, defective repairs, or maintenance problems that could compromise the safety of the public and property.
